decision: PROTOCOL ACCEPTABLE WITH LIMITED FINITE PHYSICAL-STATE RETURN CLAIM
comments: Pre-result V1A amendment supersedes V1 resource and warmup clauses; both retained.
Three recovery energy budgets, signed magnitude/positive-only/absolute <=1 kJ, are explicit. Positive-only/absolute use cycle-mean convention rather than instantaneous PWM power.
One nominal checkpoint per dt across actual plant holdouts now explicit.
No change to numerical return thresholds or observation horizons; no results yet.
Controller state is diagnostic, so complete closed-loop-state recovery remains unproved.
